detail: Public site model exposes status and recommendations, not bank balances/account identifiers.
Coinbase first and Huntington second are human-declared ordering until independent connector-history evidence is bound.
Wallet control, signer, ENS/BNS, and human identity remain separate typed objects.
Quote/build/replay may proceed without generic authority prompts; exact signed transaction remains human terminal gate.
School of Wisdom public beacon + Atom + JSON feed provide app-independent update discovery.
